Overview

Custom Home Construction Across Toronto & the GTA

Grand Design Build manages every detail of your custom home building project, from initial concept and design through to final handover. Whether it’s a modern infill, a classic family home in Lawrence Park, or something entirely custom, our integrated design-build team delivers it on time, on budget, and to a standard the GTA’s most discerning homeowners expect.

We’ve been building custom homes across Toronto since 2011. Our clients come from Forest Hill, Rosedale, Yorkville, North York, Etobicoke, Oakville, and throughout the GTA, and they choose Grand Design Build because we treat their project the way it deserves to be treated. One team, fixed price and zero surprises.

As an HCRA licensed builder, every project we take on is backed by our 7-year structural guarantee — because we don’t just build homes. We stand behind them.

Our Process

Stages of a Custom Home Build Project

A custom build project typically goes through several stages from concept to completion. While the exact stages vary with the project and the design-build team, this is the usual process:

01

Conceptualization

You sit down with our design-build team to discuss your vision, your site, your budget, and your timeline. We conduct a detailed feasibility study — reviewing zoning bylaws, lot coverage rules, setback requirements, and any variances that may affect your design. You leave this stage with a clear picture of what’s possible, what it will cost, and how long it will take.

02

Design Development

With your vision confirmed, our in-house architects and designers develop the full design of your home: architectural drawings, structural engineering plans, 3D renderings, and interior design concepts. Having design and build under one roof means your interior flow, custom cabinetry, and lighting plans are built into the structural blueprints from day one — no costly revisions later.

03

Pre-construction

Before construction begins, we handle every permit, approval, and regulatory requirement on your behalf. In Toronto, a standard building permit takes 3 to 5 months; if your design requires a Minor Variance through the Committee of Adjustment, add 4 to 6 months. We manage the entire City of Toronto application process so your project starts moving the moment permits are issued.

04

Construction and Completion

Construction is managed by a dedicated project coordinator who is your single point of contact from approvals to handover. We coordinate all trades, manage the site daily, and keep you updated at every milestone. Our fixed-price contract means the number you agreed to is the number you pay. At completion, we walk through the finished home with you and address every item on the punch list.

What's Included

What's Included in a Custom Home Build with Grand Design Build

Every custom home we build carries the same scope of work, priced and documented before construction starts.

Permit Acquisition & Zoning Approvals

Full handling of building permits, variances, and City of Toronto approvals. We manage the paperwork so your project doesn’t stall.

Project Budgeting & Cost Estimation

Transparent pricing from day one. We produce a detailed, line-by-line budget and lock it into a fixed-price contract before construction begins.

Structural Engineering & Code Compliance

Engineering drawings, load calculations, and full adherence to Ontario Building Code requirements. Our builds are designed to last.

Custom Millwork & Built-In Solutions

Kitchens, vanities, closets, built-in shelving, and feature walls, all built to your specification by our in-house millwork team.

Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing

Full coordination and installation of HVAC, electrical, lighting, and plumbing. Every system is planned at the design stage, not retrofitted during construction.

Post-Construction Walkthrough & Warranty

Final client walkthrough, punch list completion, and a full warranty package — including our 7-year structural guarantee and Tarion enrolment where applicable.

Why Us

Why Homeowners Choose Grand Design Build

$

Fixed-Price Contracts

Most builders work cost-plus, meaning every material price spike and every unforeseen issue gets passed on to you. We work on fixed-price contracts. The number we agree on is the number you pay. We carry the budget risk, not you.

✓

HCRA Licensed & Insured

Grand Design Build is fully licensed with the Home Construction Regulatory Authority, the body that regulates new custom home building in Ontario. It means you have legal protections, warranty rights, and the assurance that your builder is held to provincial standards.

⌂

7-Year Structural Guarantee

Every custom home we deliver is backed by a 7-year structural guarantee. If something goes wrong with the structure of your home, we stand behind it — not as a marketing promise, but as a contractual obligation.

◆

One Team, Start to Finish

You communicate with our site managers directly. No hand-offs to subcontractors you’ve never met. No communication gaps between the design team and the build team. Just one firm, accountable for all of it.

Questions

FAQs

In the current GTA market, high-end custom home builds typically range from $400 to $700+ per square foot. Total cost depends on architectural complexity, material selections, and neighbourhood-specific requirements. We provide a detailed feasibility study during our initial consultation to establish a realistic, all-in budget.

In the GTA, a custom build typically takes 12 to 20 months. Phase 1 (4–6 months) covers architectural design, engineering, and City of Toronto permit approvals. Phase 2 (10–16 months) covers demolition, foundation, framing, and full interior and exterior construction.

No. Our custom build service is truly turnkey. Our in-house interior design team works alongside our architects from the beginning, so interior flow, custom cabinetry, and lighting plans are integrated into the structural blueprints — preventing costly changes later in the build.

In a volatile market, a fixed-price contract protects the homeowner from material price spikes and labour shortages. Unlike cost-plus builders who pass every extra dollar on to you, our fixed-price model means we manage the budget risk. You get a guaranteed price for your defined scope of work.

A standard building permit for a new home usually takes 3 to 5 months. If your design requires a Minor Variance through the Committee of Adjustment, plan for an additional 4 to 6 months. We handle the entire application to keep your project moving as fast as municipal timelines allow.
